scope: Components MC-01..MC-28 from INV19_v4.2.0_Missing_Components_Comprehensive_Checklist.md after the 5.0.0 pass

status_legend.DONE_ON_THIS_HOST: implemented and evidenced on Linux x86-64; other platforms unverified
status_legend.BLOCKED: cannot complete without an external input named in the detail

components.name: Reproducible pk_core dependency
components.detail: Preflight, lock file, pyproject, fail-fast and dependency-vs-failure distinction implemented and tested (absent/wrong-version/corrupt -> BLOCKED; pinned -> GO). Remaining: authoritative pk_core source, exact version, digest, licence, mirror, transitive SBOM entries; the pk_core 100-item component gate still cannot execute.

components.name: Native io_uring adapter
components.detail: Raw-syscall io_uring backend with probe, ring validation, rollback, CLOEXEC, fork guard, exactly-once CQE delivery, stale-CQE drop, cancellation, bounded submit retry, CQ-overflow flush, shutdown drain; 17 real-kernel tests. Remaining: multiple kernel versions; arm64 memory ordering; explicit SQ-full stress (SQ drains per submit).

components.name: Native Windows IOCP adapter
components.detail: IOCP adapter implemented (port, association, pinned OVERLAPPED, GetQueuedCompletionStatusEx, CancelIoEx/ERROR_NOT_FOUND, wake + bounded shutdown) and Win32/Winsock/NTSTATUS tables tested; never executed (no Windows runner) and not wired into AsyncHost's fd-based submit path.

components.name: Native epoll adapter
components.detail: epoll adapter: CLOEXEC, ADD/MOD/DEL, LT default / ET with drain, ONESHOT rejected, ERR/HUP/RDHUP preserved, generation tokens, bounded fair event arrays, wakeup; 11 real-kernel tests.

components.name: Native kqueue adapter
components.detail: kqueue adapter implemented (READ/WRITE filters, EV_EOF/EV_ERROR, generations, wakeup); never executed (no macOS/BSD runner).

components.name: Portable fallback I/O implementation
components.detail: selectors-based fallback with real I/O, idempotent socketpair wakeup, generations, quotas; cannot be disabled; engagement counted. Threaded fallback not used (N/A). Other platforms unverified.

components.name: Host backend capability detection
components.detail: Typed HostCapabilities, operational probes, reason codes, deterministic selection, admin disable, diagnostic-only override, capability snapshot without hostname. Windows/BSD probes are code-only.

components.name: Streaming credit integration
components.detail: Readiness->credit (coalesced, bounded pool, EAGAIN-safe, close returns credit) tested on epoll/portable. Blocked: authoritative INV-17 package; completion-backend streams (io_uring POLL_ADD) not implemented.

components.name: Completion/future integration
components.detail: Exactly-once futures, duplicate/stale detection, cancel/complete/shutdown races, unmapped-error quarantine all tested. Blocked: authoritative INV-18 package.

components.name: Async ABI / waitable-set integration
components.detail: Race-safe waitable set (no lost wakeups, coalescing, capacity, bounded reap). Blocked: authoritative INV-15 ABI; architecture-independence unverified (one arch).

components.name: Versioned typed interface schemas
components.detail: JSON Schema 2020-12 for BACKEND/ARM/REAP/ERROR, frozen v1, fixtures, malformed fixtures, round-trip, negotiation, breaking-change detector in CI tests.

components.name: Structured error translation taxonomy
components.detail: Canonical codes with retry/transient/cancel/timeout classes; POSIX, io_uring, Win32, Winsock, NTSTATUS tables; UNKNOWN_HOST_ERROR counted; fixed messages. BSD golden table not generated (no BSD host).

components.name: Operation timeout/retry/backpressure policy
components.detail: Monotonic deadlines, bounded retry with budget/jitter/idempotency gate, admission with reason codes, per-tenant limits, circuit breaker with half-open probe.

components.name: Production configuration system
components.detail: Typed schema, precedence, immutable candidate, atomic swap, hook rollback, operator rollback, restart-required classification, digest provenance, secrets refused.

components.name: Security identity/capability enforcement
components.detail: HMAC capabilities (actions, resource scope, expiry, revocation), authorization before allocation, cross-tenant/workload denial audited, per-scope accounting incl. buffer bytes. Residual timing channel documented as accepted, not mitigated.

components.name: Supply-chain and artifact verification
components.detail: CycloneDX SBOM, content-addressed source revision, Ed25519-signed manifest with verifier (tamper detected). Blocked: KMS-bound release key, advisory feed (scan INDETERMINATE), pk_core pin, component licence.

components.name: Sensitive-data/key handling policy implementation
components.detail: Classification, central redaction (nested, value patterns, log injection), traceback-free diagnostics, key references with rotation/expiry/revocation/outage fail-closed. Blocked: approved KMS integration.

components.name: Tamper-evident security audit trail
components.detail: Hash chain, signed checkpoints, offline verifier (modify/delete/reorder/truncate/forged signature caught), bounded buffering with fail-closed exhaustion, retention/access/minimisation policy.

components.name: Fault recovery and failover machinery
components.detail: Health states, stall detection, bounded recovery, exactly-once failure of in-flight ops, quarantine + failover, operator unquarantine, event-loss and init-failure injection.

components.name: Measured performance baseline and release thresholds
components.detail: Reproducible harness, env capture, p50..p99.9/max, single/multi-workload/multi-thread throughput, CPU/op, context switches, overload and recovery, baseline + regression decision. Linux x86-64 only; power/thermal not measurable here.

components.name: Comprehensive resource accounting
components.detail: Global/tenant/workload/backend quotas, soft/hard thresholds, admin reserve, reserve-before-allocate with rollback, double-release and negative detection, leak detection, fairness under hot tenant.

components.name: Production observability stack
components.detail: Metrics spec with label allow-lists and series caps, Prometheus exposition, histograms, structured redacted logs, W3C trace context through submit/resolve, decision explain log, alert rules, dashboard.

components.name: Adjacent-layer integration test suite
components.detail: End-to-end scenarios run against reference INV-17/18/15; INV-13 and SCH-01 have no reference or authoritative binding here.

components.name: Cross-platform compatibility certification
components.detail: Matrix generator with revision-bound evidence; Linux x86-64 (normal, io_uring admin-disabled, low-resource) recorded on this host. Windows, macOS, BSD, arm64: UNVERIFIED.

components.name: Fuzz/security/adversarial test suite
components.detail: Seeded state-machine and input fuzzing, 256-caller and race adversaries, abuse cases, regression corpus (6 entries, 2 found by this pass). Native sanitizers N/A (no C code).

components.name: Soak/burst/fleet/disaster test suite
components.detail: 900 s soak with slope-based leak detection, burst (submit/completion/cancel/retry storms, churn), 200-identity fleet, disaster (backend loss, audit loss, key outage, bad config, SIGKILL restart). Blocked: multi-hour release soak.

components.name: Machine-readable production evidence bundle
components.detail: 100 chained, signed evidence records; verifier with cross-validation; negative self-test (missing evidence, altered artifact, stale revision, failed-as-pass, forged result, pk_core absent, two known-bad mutants).

components.name: Operational governance artifacts
components.detail: ADRs, requirements, threat model, release/canary/rollback, runbook, lifecycle, exception register, review plan, dashboard written. Blocked: named owners/approvers, ADR approval, staging rollback, recurring reviews, countersigned exit record.

missing_components.name: Reproducible pk_core dependency
missing_components.detail: No vendored framework, lock/pin, install manifest, or other reproducible mechanism is included to provide pk_core; production conformance tests are therefore blocked.

missing_components.name: Native io_uring adapter
missing_components.detail: The repository models io_uring semantics by name but contains no Linux io_uring system-call adapter, submission/completion queue implementation, feature probing, or kernel-version compatibility tests.

missing_components.name: Native Windows IOCP adapter
missing_components.detail: The repository models IOCP semantics by name but contains no CreateIoCompletionPort/GetQueuedCompletionStatus integration, OVERLAPPED lifecycle handling, cancellation, or Windows compatibility tests.

missing_components.name: Native epoll adapter
missing_components.detail: No epoll_create/epoll_ctl/epoll_wait adapter or edge/level-trigger policy is implemented.

missing_components.name: Native kqueue adapter
missing_components.detail: No kqueue/kevent adapter or BSD/macOS compatibility coverage is implemented.

missing_components.name: Portable fallback I/O implementation
missing_components.detail: portable is an in-memory semantics label, not an implemented selector/poll/threaded fallback that can perform host I/O.

missing_components.name: Host backend capability detection
missing_components.detail: select() chooses from a caller-supplied set; the repository has no OS/kernel/runtime probe that constructs that set or records why a backend is unavailable.

missing_components.name: Streaming credit integration
missing_components.detail: No executable integration maps readiness events into INV-17 stream credit/backpressure semantics.

missing_components.name: Completion/future integration
missing_components.detail: No executable integration resolves INV-18 futures from completion events, including cancellation and terminal error propagation.

missing_components.name: Async ABI / waitable-set integration
missing_components.detail: The declared INV-15 dependency is not exercised by code or integration tests.

missing_components.name: Versioned typed interface schemas
missing_components.detail: PK_ASYNC_BACKEND/1, PK_ASYNC_ARM/1 and PK_ASYNC_REAP/1 are prose identifiers only; no machine-readable schema/WIT/protocol definitions or fixtures are present.

missing_components.name: Structured error translation taxonomy
missing_components.detail: Completion errors are passed through as arbitrary strings; no stable error codes, retryability classification, source errno/NTSTATUS mapping, or unknown-error quarantine exists.

missing_components.name: Operation timeout/retry/backpressure policy
missing_components.detail: Descriptor cancellation now exists, but operation deadlines, bounded retry/backoff/jitter, admission control, load shedding, and circuit breaking are not implemented.

missing_components.name: Production configuration system
missing_components.detail: No declarative config schema, provenance record, validation/activation transaction, environment/site override mechanism, or rollback implementation is present.

missing_components.name: Security identity/capability enforcement
missing_components.detail: No authentication, authorization, least-privilege capability boundary, or tenant/workload isolation enforcement exists beyond a local descriptor count.

missing_components.name: Supply-chain and artifact verification
missing_components.detail: No signed release manifest, digest/provenance verification, SBOM, dependency lock, vulnerability policy automation, or EOL enforcement is present.

missing_components.name: Sensitive-data/key handling policy implementation
missing_components.detail: No explicit secret-redaction path, encryption/key rotation mechanism, or defined executable behavior for identity/key/time-service outages exists.

missing_components.name: Tamper-evident security audit trail
missing_components.detail: No append-only/tamper-evident audit event stream, retention policy, privacy controls, or export mechanism is implemented.

missing_components.name: Fault recovery and failover machinery
missing_components.detail: Failure modes are listed in the contract, but health/stall detection, restart/replay semantics, failover, quarantine/disable control, and fault-injection recovery tests are absent.

missing_components.name: Measured performance baseline and release thresholds
missing_components.detail: No benchmark harness/results, percentile thresholds, overload/recovery measurements, per-tenant overhead results, power/thermal data, capacity model, or performance regression gate is included.

missing_components.name: Comprehensive resource accounting
missing_components.detail: max_descriptors bounds one resource dimension only; buffers, queue depth, memory, threads, handles, completion backlog, per-tenant quotas, and fairness are not modeled or enforced.

missing_components.name: Production observability stack
missing_components.detail: snapshot() provides a local bounded diagnostic view, but metrics export, structured logs, trace propagation, decision reasons, lineage correlation, retention/export policy, dashboards, and alerts are absent.

missing_components.name: Adjacent-layer integration test suite
missing_components.detail: No executable tests integrate INV-17, INV-18, INV-15, INV-13, or SCH-01.

missing_components.name: Cross-platform compatibility certification
missing_components.detail: No Linux/Windows/BSD/macOS CI matrix, architecture matrix, kernel/API support table, or supported-version compatibility matrix is present.

missing_components.name: Fuzz/security/adversarial test suite
missing_components.detail: No fuzzing or threat-model-derived tests cover malformed descriptors/events, privilege boundaries, spoofing, replay, side channels, or resource-exhaustion attacks.

missing_components.name: Soak/burst/fleet/disaster test suite
missing_components.detail: No long-running soak, burst, fleet-scale, partition, reconnect, degraded-control-plane, or disaster tests are present.

missing_components.name: Machine-readable production evidence bundle
missing_components.detail: CHECKLIST.json contains requirements, not completion evidence. No generated evidence ledger or gate result is shipped in this archive, and the external gate cannot run without pk_core.

missing_components.name: Operational governance artifacts
missing_components.detail: README contains a short day-0/day-1/day-2 note and SLO text, but no named owner/escalation, approved ADR artifact, canary procedure, compatibility matrix, patch/EOL SLA, incident runbook, recurring review records, exception register, or independently executable production exit record.
